summary.text: Morgan Rielly is a Democratic state representative from Westbrook, Maine, who has represented District 127 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an author who has also worked as an oyster farmer and as a paralegal at an immigration law firm.

paragraphs.text: Rielly lives in Westbrook, Maine, and graduated from Westbrook High School.
He earned a B.A. in government and legal studies and in religion from Bowdoin College in 2018.
His career experience includes working as an author, an oyster farmer and a paralegal with an immigration law firm.
Rielly took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Engrossed Bills Committee for 2025-2026.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
